objective: Close source candidate omission within the six registered C22 asset/window slots and ORIGINAL_BASELINE by an independent prefilter upstream-evaluation obligation per scheduled C27 prebar; bind evidence in a private persistent SHA chain; prepare strictly descriptive one-financed-book net-log comparisons versus CASH/original without claiming realized out-of-sample profitability from unexecuted variants.

C28_source_obligation.independent_slot_generator: For every supplied registered asset × relevant frozen variant plus original baseline at every scheduled C27 bar, derive eligibility from C22 original session calendar. Do NOT use candidate signals to decide which slots exist.
C28_source_obligation.source_capture: Call a supplied prefilter evaluator exactly once when eligible (upstream of policy/financial filters); emit returned IDs even if zero. A zero-candidate evaluation must be a signed local source record, not an absent record.
C28_source_obligation.source_replay: Match every source-emitted ID to exactly one original C27 prebar OBSERVED_ONLY/RESERVED/REFUSED/NO_FILL/NO_SIGNAL row. Reject candidate omitted from either side, wrong asset/variant, future event, duplicate slot and undocumented skipped evaluation.
C28_source_obligation.excludes: Does NOT prove all conceivable market opportunities, that all possible assets were placed in registered universe, or that caller-provided source taps truthfully originate from exchange or broker.
C28_source_obligation.local_auth: Original prefilter wrapper direct call result and C27 saved snapshot digest; both local, not independent trusted external origin.

C28_tap_archive.format: Private 0700 directory, exclusive 0600 content-addressed numbered JSON records, SHA256 prior-record chain, fsync, external writer O_EXCL lock, binding to original C27 frame hash and manifest/registered calendar. Full replay on every restart.

C28_prospective_financing.metric: Exact original source C22 compound net log growth across one continuously financed account after fees and external costs, paired to declared known-before-start CASH benchmark rate. One original policy and six fixed research variants are distinct arms, never independently capital-reset.
C28_prospective_financing.assignment: Every arm assignment must be frozen before its return block starts. No post-view changes. Carry exposure crossing arms disallowed for unattributed one-arm result.
C28_prospective_financing.model: Descriptive bookkeeping only. Real randomized independent and identically distributed return assumptions, tail bounds and causal inference are not proven by completed source accounts.
C28_prospective_financing.cannot_certify: Without independent broker activity receipts (C25), decision-time quote+receipt and queue verification (C26), instrumented source-tap registered slots (C28), original/control execution and prospectively registered dependence/multiplicity inference, no real OOS alpha or optimal-hour GO.
C28_prospective_financing.controls: CASH and ORIGINAL_BASELINE must each have observed, source-reconciled original market data for a meaningful test; no simulated fill can be presented as executed.
